title: NucleiDualSignalTriageMetadata
description: Standardized schema for deterministic vulnerability triage dispositions and CISA-KEV corroboration in Nuclei templates.

triage_disposition.description: Deterministic operational triage disposition for security response teams.

cisa_kev_active.description: Whether this vulnerability is actively weaponized and listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

evidence_basis.description: Evidence basis distinguishing active verified exploitation from passive version checks.

never_equate_scan_to_exploit.description: Policy marker ensuring raw scanner detection is not equated to active exploitation without corroborating evidence.

compliance_impact.description: Relevant compliance control mappings (e.g. SOC2_CC7.1, ISO_27001_A.12.6.1, PCI_DSS_6.2).
